32-shape-morphing-gallery.visual_critic_note: Clean grid layout with intentional Tol palette, but 6 of 9 cells are empty in the screenshot due to staggered init timing, leaving the gallery looking mostly unrendered.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.encoding_integrity_note: All bar/area charts correctly start from zero baseline, d3.pack() encodes circle size by area (honest), and no lie-factor violations; main weaknesses are hardcoded domains ([0,1], [0,1.2]) throughout and no key functions on data joins, but both are acceptable in this synthetic-data morphing demo.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.stress_test_note: Purely automated animation gallery with no user interactions eliminates brush/zoom/touch risks entirely, but loopMorph chains lack .interrupt() guards that could cause transition conflicts if page visibility changes or transitions are externally interrupted.
32-shape-morphing-gallery.cognitive_load_note: 9-cell gallery is a single conceptual unit and reads cleanly when rendered, but 6 of 9 cells are blank in the screenshot due to staggered 300ms init delays — a static capture flaw, not a design one; concurrent independent animations in all 9 cells could compete for attention, and the scatter/bar and horizontal/vertical demos push the 8-color warning threshold.
